subject: Harvest Medical: Portal onboarding, MSA redlines & e-sign authority
messages:
From: Olivia Nguyen <olivia.nguyen@harvestmedical.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@harvestmedical.com
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Portal onboarding & MSA redlines — kickoff

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at Harvest is ready to move forward with portal onboarding (Coupa). Before we start provisioning vendor accounts we need to align on the MSA redlines and the Order Form fields that the portal will present during PO acceptance. Two quick asks: 

- Can Redwood accept the limited-liability language we proposed in §7? (we attached the suggested wording in-line)
- For e-sign authority: we need to capture entity-level signer attributes in the portal (entity name + signatory role + DUNS). Can you confirm how Redwood captures and stores that info and whether DocuSign can be the authority source?

We'd like to get legal sync and a short walkthrough before our internal go/no-go on 4/20. Attaching our procurement checklist and a fresh Order Form sample.

Regards,
Olivia Nguyen
Senior Procurement Manager
Harvest Medical

Subject: Re: Portal onboarding & MSA redlines — kickoff

Hi Olivia — thanks for the checklist and sample. Looping in Legal (Marissa + Mateo) and Contracts Ops (Kim) to coordinate redlines and the e-sign data capture spec. High-level plan from our side: 

1) Redwood will review Harvest's proposed limited-liability language and provide counter-language by end of day Friday (4/13).
2) We will produce a portal field map for Order Form -> Coupa visible fields (including DUNS, signatory role, entity id).
3) If DocuSign is the desired signature authority, we'll generate a DocuSign envelope template that captures entity-level signer metadata and persists a signed envelope ID in our audit log.
4) Schedule a 30-min legal + procurement walkthrough next week (I suggested 4/17 or 4/18).

Action items: Marissa / Mateo — can you review the attached Harvest MSA redline and call out any non-starters (especially indemnity/liability and data/retention clauses)? Kim — can you prepare the portal field mapping draft and a short note on where we store signer attributes (encrypted KMS + audit log retention policy).

I'll stand up a JIRA ticket for the onboarding tasks and drop the DocuSign draft once Legal signs off.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships & GTM
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Harvest_MSA_redline_v1.docx (docx, 110 KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, olivia.nguyen@harvestmedical.com
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding & MSA redlines — legal review notes

Hi all — quick read of Harvest's proposed redline and Vivek's MSA_v1. Summary below (high-level only):

- §7 Limitation of Liability: Harvest's language expands cap to 12 months of fees and includes carveouts for consequential damages. We can accept a 6-month fee cap and a narrowly tailored consequential-damages carveout for confirmed data-breach remediation costs.
- Indemnity: remove blanket third-party IP indemnity for customer-supplied assets; propose limited-to-claims-arising-from-customer-content.
- Data retention/logs: propose explicit retention window and customer-requested exports; recommend 7 years for audit logs only for enterprise customers.

Suggested edits: I've attached a tracked-change doc (Harvest_MSA_redline_v2.docx) that marks the proposed language. Two items we need external confirmation on before finalizing: (1) whether Harvest requires DocuSign composite signatures across multiple legal entities (i.e., same envelope for two invoices/entities) and (2) how Procurement wants DUNS vs. internal vendor id to be surfaced in Coupa.

If both answers are "yes/multi-entity", we need to update the Order Form to include an entity selector at checkout and change the DocuSign template to capture multiple signers with entity tags.

Available for a 30-min sync tomorrow 4/13 at 10:00 AM PT.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Harvest_MSA_redline_v2.docx (docx, 120 KB)]

From: Mike Olson <mike.olson@harvestmedical.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Nguyen <olivia.nguyen@harvestmedical.com>, procurement@harvestmedical.com
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding & MSA redlines — legal review notes

Marissa / Vivek — thanks for the quick turnaround and clear edits. A few replies inline: 

- Liability cap: Harvest can accept 6 months of fees provided we retain limited carveouts for regulatory fines; acceptable if Redwood excludes consequential damages except where required by law.
- Multi-entity signing: yes — Harvest requires a multi-entity signing option for customers that represent multiple legal entities on a single procurement (common in group purchasing). Prefer a single envelope with multiple recipient roles bound to entity tags.
- DUNS vs internal vendor ID: Procurement prefers DUNS displayed prominently; internal ID optional.

We can join the 4/13 10:00 AM PT sync. Also — can Redwood provide a short screencast of the portal's e-sign flow and an example DocuSign envelope mapping? That will help our security/compliance team.

Regards,
Mike Olson
VP Legal Operations
Harvest Medical
[Attachment: Harvest_Signer_Matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 28 KB)]

- Contracts Ops to update Order Form to include an entity selector and a DUNS field, and share the field map (Kim) — target 4/14 EOD.
- Engineering to produce a 5-min screencast of the e-sign flow plus a sample DocuSign envelope mapping (Mateo) — target 4/15.
- I'll schedule the 30-min joint walk-through for 4/17 10:00 AM PT and create JIRA PROCON-1124 with tasks and acceptance criteria; HubSpot deal HM-2028-043 will be updated to reflect redline status.

Please reply if any of the deadlines above are infeasible. Otherwise I'll send calendar invites and the DocuSign draft once Marissa pushes the finalized redline.
